subject: Current TGP2 draft differs from compiler ACK: table3 and8-byte manifest
body: Current pipeline_format.h draft is NOT compatible with compiler ACK1792938935279207868. Lines75.. currently still document table3 for storage images and tegu_pipeline_requirement only {binding,kind_flags}8bytes; parser binding<32. Agreed actual mapping is image/texture table1[N], sampler table2[N], internal sampler2[256], N0..255. An8-byte record cannot cross-check descriptor set, array count, table/entry, image dimension/arrayed/MS/depth/numeric class/storage format, dummy requirement, bufferFAUslot or atomic access. Fixed code offset320 can be coherent with fixed-capacity manifest, but the prior ACK explicitly requires checked serialized manifest/code offsets and sizes. Please revise/publish concrete definitions before wiring consumers or asking compiler to emit it. Keep legacy TGP1 untouched. Also texture and sampler Metal slot capacities are not nativebinding bounds. I am not editing production; this is the requested interface review. Positive observation: current buffer-mask/required-set and exactlength checks are useful and should remain in revised parser.
